QuestionStmt.S: A force acting on a body of mass 5 kg is $(4\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k})$ N. If the body is initially at rest then the magnitude of its velocity at the end of 10 second in m/s will be

Solution.S:
Given: mass $m = 5$ kg, force $\vec{F} = 4\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$ N.

Acceleration: $\vec{a} = \frac{\vec{F}}{m} = \frac{4}{5}\hat{i} - \frac{2}{5}\hat{j} + \frac{3}{5}\hat{k}$.

Initial velocity $\vec{v}_0 = 0$. Using $\vec{v} = \vec{v}_0 + \vec{a}t$:

$$\vec{v} = \left(\frac{4}{5}\hat{i} - \frac{2}{5}\hat{j} + \frac{3}{5}\hat{k}\right) \times 10 = 8\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}$$

Magnitude: $|\vec{v}| = \sqrt{8^2 + (-4)^2 + 6^2} = \sqrt{64 + 16 + 36} = \sqrt{116} = 2\sqrt{29}$.

Thus the correct option is B: $2\sqrt{29}$.
